owner: Scroll and Scorpion native server exchanges over borrowed streams
dependency_delta: Both optional server features explicitly enable tokio/macros for select; Scroll adds dev-only test-util for paused-time controls. No dependency version or Cargo.lock change. Grammar-only and client/TLS feature boundaries remain independent.

environment.note: Root alone runs Cargo; every gate sets both stable directories and uses --locked --offline. Luna ran no Cargo.

commands.classification: Unchanged baseline formatting, not a new-source formatting pass
commands.note: Nine pre-existing formatting hunks: Reply::render vector and match comma, Source::receive wrapping, four native dispatch match commas, request-limit error wrapping, and old malformed-request test wrapping. Native file minus only the additive wrapper/docs and test-module suffix compares exactly to baseline; no changed line appears in formatter differences.

implementation.api: Each native server module adds serve_connection_until_shutdown. One biased select polls caller shutdown first, returns io::ErrorKind::Interrupted on stop, otherwise returns the unchanged serve_connection result.

timing.scroll: Unchanged ServerConfig::timeout: 30s default, one request/handler/write/flush budget; expiry stays TimedOut. Shutdown does not renew it.
timing.scorpion: The native server has no built-in deadline. Caller outer timeout_at/actor policy stays authoritative; a 31s successful exchange within a 40s caller budget proves the companion adds no 30s timer.

implementation.ownership: Both APIs borrow &mut stream and handler/source. Cancellation drops inline work before return, but never calls stream shutdown or drops the carrier. External future drop also releases inline work. Hosts own admission, tasks, joining, TLS, close and any grace period.
implementation.effects: Partial request consumption, emitted bytes and source/handler effects cannot be undone. Caller must retire a carrier after cancellation or partial failure. Synchronous or continuously-ready source/carrier work remains cooperatively cancellable.
implementation.handoff: Ordinary Scorpion success still returns Option<Request> and leaves later bytes unread. Tests preserve R range/exclusive end and whole-file total, native binary response, M desired type, S version and 70 readiness, I capability bytes and 00 status. Upload and interactive session drivers remain unimplemented.

native_comparison.method: Normalize CRLF to LF and trim final whitespace. Remove only each new shutdown companion with its documentation, plus the new cfg(test)/path/module declaration. Compare the entire remaining server source to baseline, including native config, parsing, dispatch, encoders and existing tests.

cases: Ready shutdown wins before native I/O/source polling, including fully-ready Scroll exchange.
Started request read, handler/source, response write and flush cancel; inline source guards drop before return; borrowed stream is neither shut down nor dropped.
Scroll partial request consumption and partial response write remain visible; complete emitted output survives flush cancellation.
Dropping each wrapper cancels the active handler/source and releases its borrow without detached work.
Paused Scroll fixed 10s native deadline spans 4s request read, 4s handler and blocked flush, without renewal.
Paused Scorpion caller absolute deadline expires at exactly 7s; 31s source succeeds under caller 40s deadline with no native server timer.
Scroll ordered languages, abstract flag, UDC class, MIME/language, Unicode author, verbatim dates and exact body bytes survive successful wrapper exchange; trailing bytes remain unread.
Scorpion exact R/M/S/I request/results and reply bytes preserve range/binary framing and caller-owned later phases.
Scroll malformed request keeps native 59 refusal; zero native timeout refuses before I/O.
coverage.limits: Controlled caller-supplied carriers and existing native/duplex/TCP/TLS suites qualify in-process exchange behavior. No new listener, TLS policy, installed product, radio, independent peer or product-repin qualification is claimed.
